evals.title: Switch local to Hub
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `policy.skore_mode` is `local`.
- `experiments/01_baseline.py` has `skore.Project(name="load-forecast",
  mode="local", workspace=str(PROJECT_ROOT / "reports"))`.
- `add-python-package` is installed.
- `SKORE_HUB_API_KEY` is set. `SKORE_HUB_URI` is unset.
- `skore` is on PATH.
- `persist-ml-git` and `triage-ml-task` are installed.]

Switch the default destination to Hub workspace acme-corp at
https://skore.probabl.ai for project load-forecast. Transfer now,
not a dry run.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run `python -m skore_skills status`. - Load `add-python-package` for Skore at Hub mode. - Name `skore sync load-forecast --from=local --to=hub` with `--from-workspace` on `reports/`, `--to-workspace=acme-corp`, and `--host https://skore.probabl.ai`. It must NOT: - Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed). - Call `skore.login` or `Project.sync` in Python. - Run `skore hub api-key generate` when `SKORE_HUB_API_KEY` is set.
expectations: Run `python -m skore_skills status`.
Load `add-python-package` for Skore at Hub mode.
Name `skore sync load-forecast --from=local --to=hub` with `--from-workspace` on `reports/`, `--to-workspace=acme-corp`, and `--host https://skore.probabl.ai`.
Persist `python -m skore_skills policy set skore_mode hub`.
Rewrite the Project init to Hub form (`mode="hub"`, `workspace="acme-corp"`, `host="https://skore.probabl.ai"`, no `skore.login`).
Run `python -m skore_skills git end-turn --stage evaluate`.

The response does NOT: Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed).
The response does NOT: Call `skore.login` or `Project.sync` in Python.
The response does NOT: Run `skore hub api-key generate` when `SKORE_HUB_API_KEY` is set.
The response does NOT: Pass `--hub-url`.
The response does NOT: Run `git commit` in this skill.
The response does NOT: Ask a first-time local / Hub / MLflow destination pick.
The response does NOT: Pass `--from-workspace` / `--to-workspace` as an MLflow flag.

- `policy.skore_mode` is `local`.
- Project name is `load-forecast`.
- `add-python-package` is installed.
- `SKORE_HUB_API_KEY` is unset. `SKORE_HUB_URI` is unset.
- `skore hub api-key list` has no row for this host and workspace.
- `skore` is on PATH.]

Switch the default destination to Hub workspace acme-corp at
https://skore.probabl.ai. Transfer now, not a dry run.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Run `python -m skore_skills status`. - Run `skore hub api-key generate --host https://skore.probabl.ai --workspace acme-corp` and wait for its browser device login before `skore sync`. - After that key exists, name `skore sync` from `local` to `hub` with `--to-workspace=acme-corp` and `--host https://skore.probabl.ai`. expectations: Run `python -m skore_skills status`.
Run `skore hub api-key generate --host https://skore.probabl.ai --workspace acme-corp` and wait for its browser device login before `skore sync`.
After that key exists, name `skore sync` from `local` to `hub` with `--to-workspace=acme-corp` and `--host https://skore.probabl.ai`.
Persist `policy set skore_mode hub` and rewrite the Project init with `workspace="acme-corp"` and `host="https://skore.probabl.ai"`.

The response does NOT: Put catalog skill ids, HITL, `G-PKG-NAME` / `G-ENV-MGR` / `G-SKORE-MODE` / `G-TABULAR` / `G-CV-SPLITTER`, or `python -m skore_skills` / `env add` in user-facing questions or the close narrative (trailing `G-REPORT-LOCATOR` / `G-AUDIT-FINDING` and unmanaged `pixi add` / `uv add` / `pip install` lines are allowed).
The response does NOT: Stop only because `SKORE_HUB_API_KEY` is unset.
The response does NOT: Call `skore.login` or `Project.sync` in Python.
The response does NOT: Run `skore sync` before `skore hub api-key generate`.
The response does NOT: Pass `--hub-url` or `--force`.
The response does NOT: Read `~/.skore.hub/credentials.json` or `.skore` for the key.
